discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B014 (packet 214, Disney Store 2018); reuses 214 keys. 30 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked, snippets only. New: Mickey Mouse Memories 12-set series (sets only, designs unnamed), Aug Park Pack pins, Marvel 10th 7-pin LE, Mulan 20th 2-pin LE, RBI heart 2-pin set, DSSH surprise Pooh LE 150, PTD 18 Dec 2018 flip. Holds added: Jan Park Pack month conflict (Fantasia box labelled Dec 2017 by DPB), Feb-Apr Park Pack possible hiatus, Aug Rapunzel pin naming. Released: Aug Park Pack pins (named on DPB page). Kept: RBI princess split, Incredibles EU members, Mary Poppins date. Resellers (yourwdwstore, toywiz, millerbros, buydisneypins) not used as evidence.
